operabilityChecker.loadMethod: read exact source bytes → SHA-256 authenticate → compile(buffer) → exec in isolated namespace; no importlib/SourceFileLoader; no __pycache__ selection

findingDispositions.response: v2 authenticates every declared local executable by hashing the exact source byte buffer, then compile()/exec() of that buffer in an isolated module namespace. Path-based importlib loaders are never used. Undeclared local imports are rejected. Retained probe TRC2-ADV-PYC-IGNORED plants a timestamp-valid malicious .pyc beside authentic source and requires that the marker is never written while the authenticated source BINDING/check API remains available.

v2 removes the module-global mint token. HostRequestIngressV2 holds a private nonserializable MintGateV2. Projection accepts only exact-type instances registered by that gate. object.__new__ plus slot injection, copy/deepcopy, pickle/unpickle, wrong-authority instances, registry-style lookalikes, and public construction all refuse with typed codes. Honest residual: this is a design model; production Rust module privacy owns the real capability boundary; same-process memory/debugger compromise is out of claim.
